text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I2, which must be performed 
after 250 operating hours as indicated by H250 in the above titled block
The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 01 July 2003, accepted by by eng. Mohamed Elasrrag General Manager, 
revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector
Technical Specifications
Safety Precautions
Work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 safety and healty equipment as
 safety helmet, 
 safety shoes,
 earplug, gloves pairs, breathing mask, safety glasses
Be sure that the emergency diesel is out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Measuring and checking tools.
Cleaning articles,
 Spray gun, Oil can.
Magnetic pick up flexible.
Work to be Carried Out
Take an oil sample from engine crankcase to be analyzed, add 
 or change, if it is required.
Clean cooling system.
Treat any leakage if it is required.
